commit_message: Implement ADR 0144 hosted and enterprise model backends
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0144 hosted model backends
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0144 on the current ADR 0141/0147/0153/0148/0151 baseline. Adds Hosted API and Enterprise ModelBackend adapters shared by read-only questions and the write-capable NativeAgentRuntime, OS-protected machine-local credential ownership, explicit NetworkAccess approval, frozen per-run backend selection, structured provider failure mapping, honest capability reporting, and sanitized Remote AI Studio processing posture while preserving Agent Host mutation/completion ownership, ADR 0153 confinement preferences, and the current project-writer lifecycle.

## Validation

Requires Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation because backend and credential selection UI changes.
